_note: Labels here are OBSERVATIONS. A03 reports what is visibly present and never what it means. 'knife' is an observation; 'graphic violence' is a conclusion belonging to A11, which has the clause text and an advocate.
_purpose: Presence only. 'weapon visible' is the observation; whether it breaches AF-08 or AF-02 depends on the environment, the handling and the framing, none of which a single frame settles.
